title: Follow the Redirect
description: GET http://127.0.0.1:18084/legacy does not return the expected API body.
mission: Inspect the status and headers, follow the server's destination, and successfully request the current API endpoint.
success: You followed the redirect to the current endpoint.

lesson.what_happened: The legacy endpoint returned a redirect through its Location header.
lesson.be_careful: Redirects can change host; inspect destinations before forwarding credentials.

hints: Include response headers in curl output.
Look at the status code and Location header.
